commits.subject: Rename the empty duplicate dcroat to dcroat.1
commits.body:
Two glyphs were named dcroat: gid 211, U+0111, and gid 547, empty and
unencoded. fontc cannot build a duplicated name. The release keeps both; its
second reads as dcroat.1.

commits.subject: Take the vertical metrics of Corben-Bold-TTF.sfd
commits.body:
The later src/Corben-Bold-TTF.sfd states 2826/-969, as the release carries;
this file stated 2300/-940. Both state them as absolute values.

commits.subject: OS2Vendor newt
commits.body:
The family's vendor, as the Corben-Regular sources state it; this file left
it blank.

commits.subject: PANOSE serif style 15
commits.body:
This value exists only in the release, set by google/fonts 5b1755d5a in 2015;
both Bold sources state 0. 15 is what the Regular's sources state.
